verses.zh: 利慕伊勒王的言语，是他母亲教训他的真言。
verses.kjv: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.en: The words of King Lemuel — the message his mother taught him:

verses.zh: 我的儿啊，我腹中生的儿啊，我许愿得的儿啊！我当怎样教训你呢？
verses.kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.en: My son! Son that I gave birth to! Son that I promised to God! What shall I teach you?

verses.zh: 不要将你的精力给妇女；也不要有败坏君王的行为。
verses.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.en: Do not give your strength away to women, or your ways to what ruins kings.

verses.zh: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜；王子说浓酒在那里也不相宜；
verses.kjv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.en: Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, and not for rulers to crave strong drink,

verses.zh: 恐怕喝了就忘记律例，颠倒一切困苦人的是非。
verses.kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.en: or they will drink and forget the law, and take away what is fair from people who are suffering.

verses.zh: 可以把浓酒给将亡的人喝，把清酒给苦心的人喝，
verses.kjv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.en: Give strong drink to someone who is dying, and wine to someone whose heart is heavy.

verses.zh: 让他喝了，就忘记他的贫穷，不再记念他的苦楚。
verses.kjv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.en: Let them drink and forget how poor they are, and remember their misery no more.

verses.zh: 你当为哑巴开口，为一切孤独的伸冤。
verses.kjv: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.en: Speak up for people who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of everyone left with nothing.

verses.zh: 你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
verses.kjv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.en: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the poor and the needy.

verses.zh: 才德的妇人谁能得着呢？她的价值远胜过珍珠。
verses.kjv: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.en: Who can find a capable wife? She is worth far more than jewels.

verses.zh: 她丈夫心里倚靠她，必不缺少利益；
verses.kjv: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.en: Her husband trusts her completely, and he lacks nothing of value.

verses.zh: 她一生使丈夫有益无损。
verses.kjv: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.en: She does him good and never harm, all the days of her life.

verses.zh: 她寻找羊绒和麻，甘心用手做工。
verses.kjv: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.en: She looks for wool and flax and works gladly with her hands.

verses.zh: 她好像商船从远方运粮来，
verses.kjv: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.en: She is like trading ships, bringing food from far away.

verses.zh: 未到黎明她就起来，把食物分给家中的人，将当做的工分派婢女。
verses.kjv: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.en: She gets up while it is still dark to give her household food and to set the servant girls their work.

verses.zh: 她想得田地就买来；用手所得之利栽种葡萄园。
verses.kjv: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.en: She looks at a field and buys it; with what she has earned she plants a vineyard.

verses.zh: 她以能力束腰，使膀臂有力。
verses.kjv: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.en: She rolls up her sleeves and makes her arms strong.

verses.zh: 她觉得所经营的有利；她的灯终夜不灭。
verses.kjv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.en: She knows her work is worth doing, and her lamp does not go out at night.

verses.zh: 她手拿捻线竿，手把纺线车。
verses.kjv: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.en: Her hands hold the spinning stick and the spindle.

verses.zh: 她张手周济困苦人，伸手帮补穷乏人。
verses.kjv: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.en: She opens her hand to the poor and reaches out to help those in need.

verses.zh: 她不因下雪为家里的人担心，因为全家都穿着朱红衣服。
verses.kjv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.en: She is not worried about snow for her household, because they are all warmly dressed in red.

verses.zh: 她为自己制作绣花毯子；她的衣服是细麻和紫色布做的。
verses.kjv: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.en: She makes her own bed coverings; her clothes are fine linen and purple.

verses.zh: 她丈夫在城门口与本地的长老同坐，为众人所认识。
verses.kjv: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.en: Her husband is respected at the city gate, where he sits with the town elders.

verses.zh: 她做细麻布衣裳出卖，又将腰带卖与商家。
verses.kjv: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.en: She makes fine linen clothes and sells them, and supplies belts to the traders.

verses.zh: 能力和威仪是她的衣服；她想到日后的景况就喜笑。
verses.kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.en: Strength and dignity are what she wears, and she can laugh at whatever is coming.

verses.zh: 她开口就发智慧；她舌上有仁慈的法则。
verses.kjv: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.en: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and kind teaching is on her tongue.

verses.zh: 她观察家务，并不吃闲饭。
verses.kjv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.en: She watches over her household and never eats the bread of laziness.

verses.zh: 她的儿女起来称她有福；她的丈夫也称赞她，
verses.kjv: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verses.en: Her children stand up and call her happy, and her husband praises her too:

verses.zh: 说：才德的女子很多，惟独你超过一切。
verses.kjv: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.en: "Many women do capable things, but you are better than them all."

verses.zh: 艳丽是虚假的，美容是虚浮的；惟敬畏耶和华的妇女必得称赞。
verses.kjv: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.en: Charm can fool you and beauty does not last, but a woman who respects the LORD deserves the praise.

verses.zh: 愿她享受操作所得的；愿她的工作在城门口荣耀她。
verses.kjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.en: Give her the reward she has earned, and let what she has done be praised at the city gate.
